sentences.text: After the marriage, CW-1 started residing with the accused.
When CW-1 was staying with the accused , the accused No.1 started to harass CW-1 mentally and physically for petty matters and suspecting her character.
On 27-06-2022 accused assaulted CW-1 and threatened to kill her.

It is further alleged that accused used to demand CW-1 to get money from her maternal house in order to construct the house and thus subjected CW-1 to physical and mental cruelty in demand of additional dowry.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.200/2022 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were  3  C.C.No.27659/2023 enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused No.1 after hearing him and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused in the language known to him, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused No.1 was recorded.

Thereafter, the matter was set down for Smt Mahalakshmi vs Eshwara Babu on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111846389/
2 prosecution evidence.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 and P.2 documents.
The statement of accused No.1 as required U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C. is not recorded as there were no incriminating material in the evidence against the accused.
6. Heard arguments on both the sides.
I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and threatened her and thereby accused have committed  4  C.C.No.27659/2023  the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 323, 506 of IPC. &
Sec.4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.?
 2) what order?
 8. My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 and Ex.P2 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the spot panchanama.

3  10. CW-1
was examined as PW-1 Smt.Mahalakshmi.

She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that her marriage with accused No.1 was performed on 10-02-2000 and deposed after the marriage, accused looked after her well and deposed accused did not subjected her to any physical and mental cruelty, in demand of dowry and never assaulted her and threatened to kill her.
PW-1 deposed that there was petty quarrel between her and  5  C.C.No.27659/2023 accused in respect to family issues, for which she went to the police station.
There the police have took her signatures on documents.
PW-1 identified Ex.P.1 first information statement and also identified her signature at Ex.P1.
PW-1 also identified Ex.P.2 spot Panchanama and her signature at Ex.P2 and she pleaded her ignorance about the contents of Ex.P.1 and P.2.
The learned Sr.APP treated PW-1 as hostile witness and cross examined her.
During which PW-1 admitted that she and accused have compromised the matter and denied all other suggestions.
11. On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that PW-1 being the informant, key and material witness have turned hostile to the prosecution case.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.

As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was Smt Mahalakshmi vs Eshwara Babu on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111846389/

 ORDER
